text:
The median asking rent in Bocholt stands at 10.0 €/m², up 2.8 % year‑on‑year and 23.9 % over the last five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive German markets. The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.5 % and an average of 30 days on market; 20 % of listings are let within a week.

Asking rents sit 60 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 6.26 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 600 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 12.3 %. The short‑term turnover is brisk, reflecting limited supply.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 10.38 €/m² for the next 12 months, ranging between 10.05 €/m² and 10.78 €/m², a 3.8 % increase.
